rules.question: What separates two facts on one line of text?
must_match: std::snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "x%d \xC2\xB7 combo %d", shown, at.combo);

owner_lines.why: a leading dot after the backends tree node, not a separator between two facts; comment beside it

rules.note: The middle dot between facts was typed at each use in src/app and src/ui, with path_view.cpp's own kDot beside the literals. kFactSeparator is the one spelling now; a typed escape comes back only through this spelling. One row covers both folders, because a row's scope is a top folder or a single file. Decided by: concept audit M46.
